verdict.rationale: Circle supports event-driven automation via webhooks that POST to your endpoint on state changes, CCTP's ability to trigger actions on the destination chain after assets arrive, and Agent wallets with customizable spending controls/policies — but these are developer-configured integrations, not a user-facing rules engine for defining arbitrary if/then automation. Missing for 10: a dedicated no-code/low-code rules builder, conditional logic across multiple event types, and evidence of AI-native users authoring rules themselves rather than developers wiring webhooks/paymaster policies.
